notes.title: July Update: Introducing Surf Mode, Stats, New Achievements & Sale!
notes.content:
July Update: Introducing Surf Mode, Stats, New Achievements & Sale!
 We’re excited to roll out a fresh update packed with new ways to play and track your progress:
Surf Mode
Ride your favorite palette items in our brand-new Surf Mode! Master your skills and earn Steam Achievements along the way.
Stats
Ever wondered how much time you've spent surfing? Now you can check your all-time surf stats and track your progress.
4 New Steam Achievements
Challenge yourself and unlock 4 new achievements designed for Surf Mode.
Summer Sale
Don’t miss out! The game goes on sale starting July 10th.



More updates are coming soon—stay tuned!

notes.title: Preview on Juli updates!
notes.content:
Welcome!
We hope gravity has been kind to you!

We at computerfamilie are working on several rather impactful content updates and would like to let you all know what's coming over the next few weeks. Here’s what’s dropping this July:
[hr][/hr]The Adventures of Little Surfel
Is that a typo? It isn’t! Get ready to wipe out as you surf across in-game elements for maximum fun and cool new achievements. And no, we’re not jumping the shark — but there will be a bit of extra focus on riding your friendly finned companion from Swords & Sharks.
[hr][/hr]Moof! It’s Raining Cows and Dogs
Our legendary chum “Sharky McSharkson” won’t be alone for long now. He’s getting company: Cows and Dogs are coming as brand-new palette elements. Naturally, they’re bringing a fresh batch of quirky achievements for you to chase!
[hr][/hr]Little Wurfel The Musical (Update)
Over the next few weeks, we’re tuning things up! The Palette Feature will get a new musical option, letting you choose your favorite background tracks. And yes, a selection of all-new musical compositions will be added to the game to keep your ears entertained while you play.
[hr][/hr]Mark Your Calendars!
All these updates are part of our July update cycle, starting Thursday, July 3rd. So stay tuned and thanks for sticking with us!
[hr][/hr]Bonus: Special Release Sale Incoming!
From July 10th to July 17th, we’re celebrating our big July update with a Special Release Sale! The Adventures of Little Wurfel will be available at 50% off, so grab the game at a sweet discount while the wave lasts!

notes.title: Major Update - All New Palette Feature!
notes.content:
🎨 New Palette Feature Just Dropped! 🎮

We’ve just rolled out the All-New Palette Feature, giving you the power to pick your favorite background colors and create amazing combos with your top elements — including some fan favorites from Swords & Sharks! 🦈⚔️

This is just the beginning. The Palette will be the foundation for future updates, with new elements, expanded game modes, and fresh achievements coming your way. Stay tuned and start crafting your ultimate style now! 💥✨
